capabilities.name: Reusable integrator-onboarding guide
capabilities.why: Manual re-explanation wastes time and makes the first successful integration inconsistent.
capabilities.summary: A self-serve path guides a new integrator from repository setup to a first contained successful integration.
capabilities.currentState: The repository contains a documented onboarding flow and implementation entry points.

capabilities.name: Schema-derived template editor
capabilities.why: Stable schema-derived identities prevent reordered fields from scrambling operator state.
capabilities.summary: The editor derives stable field controls and validation from the current process schema.
capabilities.currentState: Source modules implement stable schema-derived field keys and an ordered editor sequence.

capabilities.name: Contained template validation gate
capabilities.why: Template changes need deterministic validation before they become reusable process definitions.
capabilities.summary: A contained command validates template structure and required expressions without publishing changes.
capabilities.currentState: The repository exposes a templates check and local test boundary.
